name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the multi-stage reward landing page. It shows the reward steps and lets the user continue an unfinished ad-view task.
disableEffect: The multi-stage reward flow will stop, and rewards for watching its ads will no longer be granted.
